intro: Uganda's economy relies on coffee, gold and farming, with oil production on the way.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Uganda is one of Africa's biggest coffee exporters. Fish from Lake Victoria, tea and gold are important. Oil fields near Lake Albert are being developed, with a pipeline to Tanzania.

chapters.title: Gorilla tourism
text: Gorilla trekking permits bring in visitors and money for conservation.

cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Uganda makes and sells to the world.
